tools.name: get_premiere_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect the code-only Premiere capability registry. Returns verified UXP routes, CEP fallbacks, experimental routes, blocked API gaps, safety level, and summary counts without requiring Premiere to be open.

official_uxp_only.description: Return only commands backed by a registered, non-diagnostic Adobe UXP/AME handler whose runtime status is not blocked or failed.

live_only.description: Return only commands with current live-verified UXP availability.

include_tools.description: Include matching tool records. Defaults to false when no filter is supplied and true when a filter is supplied.

limit.description: Maximum matching tool records to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: resolve_premiere_tool
tools.description: Resolve one Premiere command to its best code-only route and report UXP, CEP, external-code fallback, verification, and safety status. Computer Use is never returned.
